scope.generalization: tested fixture, frozen build, inputs and local machine only

independent_raw_audit.method: Independent GRZ decoding and raw receipt/CSV audit; no analysis/validation module imports.

transient_all_sources.manual_diagnostics: Bias signs mixed within each group across seeds; all primary spatiotemporal peak indices agree. Seed0 mean maps preserve main plume structure; absolute differences localized and no missing plume found. Quantile block comparisons reviewed separately from whole-field R.

steady_all_sources.duration_semantics: steady meteorological situations; 3600-second reference each; no transient carryover
steady_all_sources.manual_diagnostics: Bias signs mixed within each group across seeds; all primary spatiotemporal peak indices agree. Seed0 mean maps preserve main plume structure; absolute differences localized and no missing plume found. Quantile block comparisons reviewed separately from whole-field R.

memory_and_device_interpretation.process_memory: Sampled process-tree RSS/private, separate dotnet/Python RSS; sampled peak may miss instantaneous peak. Tree RSS can double-count shared pages.
memory_and_device_interpretation.device_memory: Device-wide memory only. WDDM process VRAM unavailable; device totals or baseline difference cannot be called process VRAM.
memory_and_device_interpretation.buffers: Application allocation/reuse counters do not represent all device memory.
memory_and_device_interpretation.kernel_time: CUDA-event cumulative kernel_device_ms differenced per situation measures device intervals.
memory_and_device_interpretation.host_time: fresh_kernel_ms/residual_kernel_ms/kernel_total_ms include launch/synchronization/status reads and are nested in host roundtrips, not additive phases.
memory_and_device_interpretation.source_counts: phase_counts are host counts of completed GPU requests, not in-kernel source counters. Direct execution evidence also requires positive device events, launch increments, single-source tests and positive four-SG output.

external_gates_owned_by_root: selected raw input post-analysis SHA verification
publication_condition: Report observed-fixture scope and explicit steady48 CPU timing variability; do not replace generated analyzed_pending_review with a claim of formal equivalence.

steady_POINT_P95_block_2.interpretation: Single-seed P95 difference exceeds its paired CPU interseed quantile contrast. Prespecified block average is below that contrast; small denominator makes the tail ratio much larger than whole-field R. Do not claim every individual tail discrepancy is below CPU variation.

humanize.style_candidate_resolution: Remaining no-model-rerun statement retained because it defines audit scope.
